decision: record inserts first (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) then reads the row back
why: SQLite runs WAL, where a read-then-write transaction can fail on a stale snapshot under concurrent reports; Postgres INSERT waits on a concurrent insert of the same key, so the read-back sees it
